verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm a live llms.txt at exa.ai/llms.txt and Markdown versions of doc pages that point agents to a full documentation index at /docs/llms.txt. First-party docs also ship agent skills that teach coding agents how to search, retrieve content, and build with Exa's APIs. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI spec at any probed path, no independent or community reports of agents actually consuming these docs.
